title: Localization preserves a nonzerodivisor
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring [def-pc-scheme], let $a\in A$ be a non-zero-divisor, and let $g\in A$. Then the image of $a$ in the localization $A_g$ is a non-zero-divisor.
